text.description_html:
Design Hardware Spring Hinge 4.5" x 4.5"

Item is priced as each Hinge

Meets ANSI A156.17 for Grade 1 self closing

Dimensions and tolerances conform to ANSI - A156.17

UL Listed for Fire Rated openings up to and including 3 hour, A label openings.

Lifetime Warranty - Life of building

Includes screws

Spring hinges 3.4mm thick

Base Material: Steel

Maximum Labeled Door Size - 3'-0" wide x 7'-6" tall x 1 3/4" thick

Non-Labeled Doors - Maximum door size 4'-0" x 7'6" tall - Taller doors would require extra hinges
